name: Coco
source:
The girl who worked in the bakery with the protagonist was a bit afraid of life, but she was as gentle and careful as anyone else. Wearing is always very common. In school, it is not a good thing. She likes to drink cocoa and everyone calls her "Coco" seem to live near the protagonist's home. 

"Yeah! It's not that special brand...I got it out."

[Roughly translated from [url=http://narratorsgame.blogspot.com/2012/03/17character.html]Official website[/url]]
